beats.say: The best time to prepare for a lost phone is before you lose it.
Phones have a built in way to show where the device is on a map.
From another device you can make it ring, lock it, or wipe it clean.
It only works if the feature was already switched on before the phone went missing.
Sign in once on a computer so you know exactly where to go in a panic.
Check that it is on today, and send this to someone who always misplaces their phone.
